activationAuthority.recordShape: FrameworkActivation { package, framework, state: active | inactive | unsupported-version | off, admittedRelease, mode, provenance }
activationAuthority.home: crates/verter_session/src/framework/project_capabilities.rs (FWA1), family rule row in crates/verter_session/src/framework/families/marko.rs (REG0 shape, FWA1 writes the activation slot)
activationAuthority.abortConditionCheck: FWA1 expresses a per-package, version-admitted record: detection from PM3 resolved package facts, admission of the resolved installed version against this family's version lock, and the frameworks.<f> switch. The MRK0 abort condition does not apply.

detection.readFrom: PM3 project snapshot: the resolved installed version of `marko` for the owning package (PM2 resolution, workspace catalogs and aliases included)
neverFrom: the declared dependency range in package.json
a string-prefix version read (the displaced Svelte route V-D05 is not copied)
the presence of a marko.json taglib file

mode.note: The admitted release has one mode. The Class API is not a mode: it is excluded (XR03).

switch.auto: active only when detection finds an admitted installed release
switch.on: active only at an admitted release; on naming an unadmitted release gives unsupported-version (FWA1-AC6); in a package with no `marko` entry, on naming 6.4.3 gives active with provenance explicit
switch.off: the whole vertical does zero work for the package

activationRow.capabilityBit: FWA1's admitted result sets the Marko bit of ProjectCapabilitySnapshot, which gates the `.marko` LanguageRow::gated row in crates/verter_language/src/registry.rs (via REG0's families/marko.rs)

noWorkOf: TS-host companion projection and tsgo carrier sync (MRK6)
zeroWorkWhenInactive.lintPackSwitches: LK6 keeps only the lint.marko pack switches; it is never a second activation source.

covers: statements (import, export, static, server, client, $ scriptlets)
tsRegions.host: tsgo through the Verter LSP TypeProvider tsgo routes over the MRK6 companion
order: TsgoCompositeProvider (crates/verter_lsp/src/tsgo/composite.rs): shared tsgo first (TsgoSharedProvider, relay-shim attach)
tsRegions.verterComputedAnswer: forbidden: a TS-region answer Verter computes itself is a duplicate

operations: native HTML tag and attribute completion
attribute-tag name completion from MRK3 slots and custom-tag name completion from MRK2 discovery
concise-mode and HTML-mode structure symbols, folding and selection
carrierOnly.stepDown: answered only where LSPX11 owns(capability, position) resolves to Verter; Unknown means Verter owns

tsserver.typescriptPlugin: keeps only its existing carrier-generic carrier-store compatibility (MRK6-AC6); it carries no Marko-specific code

hostPolicy.newClientTransport: none needed: every TS-region row is a manifest row over the existing tsgo routes, so the MRK0 rescope trigger does not fire

parserAuthority.marko: Verter-owned dedicated frontend (PAR0 CL13, home H04 crates/verter_marko_syntax, owner MRK1)
